thread:
Jordan: Quick sync — metrics after go-live look okay but we need to decide next sprint slices: prioritize bug backlog vs enhancements. Data: 12 customer-reported regressions (P1/P2), 42 enhancement requests, latency 95p ~ 220ms in prod vs target 180ms.
Leah: Agree. My take: triage the 12 regressions as hotfixes; split enh into 'quick wins' vs 'bigger UX bets'.
Sam: Top error paths show ~7k errors/day on two handlers. Propose rubric we can apply quickly:
Sam: ```
- Impact: customer-facing revenue / blocked flows (1-3)
- Frequency: request volume (1-3)
- Effort: eng estimate (1-5)
- Risk: deploy / regression risk (1-5)
```
Maya: +1 to that rubric. Suggest schedule: 1-week hotfix runway for P1/P2, then a focused 2-week enhancement sprint for quick wins.
Jordan: For scope negotiation with Sales: promise ETA only for P1s. Sales asked about fast delivery on one top-customer request — recommend offering a timeboxed pilot instead of GA.
Leah: I'll start triage and tag tickets `bug/high` and add customer-impact notes. Jira link (mock): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-0001
Maya: Flagging two cheap wins to prioritize: autofill suggestion on the modal and copy tweaks in onboarding. Both low effort and high perceived polish.
Jordan: Decision checklist:
- Hotfix runway: 1 week, owners: Leah (hotfixes)
- Enhancement sprint: 2 weeks for top 5 quick wins, owner: Maya
- Telemetry & rollback: Sam to own alerts / rollback playbook
- Communication: I will update roadmap doc and send a short note to PMs + Sales
Ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> prod tonight 23:45 UTC. :rocket:
Sam: I'll draft acceptance criteria for each hotfix: repro steps, monitoring signal, automated rollback trigger.
Leah: Triage started. Pinging support for repros and customer repro steps. @Maya @Sam please add owners to the corresponding Jira tickets.
Maya: ack :thumbsup:
Jordan: Thanks all — quick 15m sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to confirm status. If we see more regressions we widen hotfix scope.
